It has actually been a pretty exciting time. I've truly enjoyed the growth and watching people learn. I've enjoyed the contributions, discussions, PMs, and laughs.

I have a passion for mathematics and a life of learning and many of you seem to also have that passion. Many of you seem to want to have that passion and are actively following along. I note the number of visits that submissions get, even more than I note the votes they get. It has continued to grow and we have continued to be in the daily list of most active subverses.

It's an honor that I'm glad you've allowed me to have. It's an honor to be able to foster this. I'm pretty impressed with you goats and the pretty rapid changes and expansions I've witnessed in this sub. You're learning, I'm learning, and it's an honor to be affording the liberty of helping to provide content that inspires you to learn about mathematics.

Chances are, you're not the only one with that question. Mathematics is poorly understood by many, and outright feared by some. Let's face that fear and difficulty. If you have a question, ask.
